description: This file is a shell script used for testing shared repository initialization and permissions in a Git environment.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or gets configuration variables for tests.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a file or directory is missing.

methods.name: test_modebits
methods.description: Checks the permission mode bits of a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test's internal clock or state.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
